change.summary: Replace native Copper Age Backport 0.1.4 with 0.1.5 to fix Sophisticated constructor ordering, including the upstream visual-config and Pale Oak recipe/tag changes

before.behavior: No Sophisticated dependency ordering. Copper constructor eagerly initializes StoragePacketHandler through Class.forName, initializing Core PacketHandler before SophisticatedCore constructor assigns its protocol version. Null protocol crashes PacketHandler construction

after.behavior: Native metadata declares optional BOTH-side AFTER dependencies on sophisticatedcore and sophisticatedstorage. Existing compatibility code and gameplay registrations remain byte-identical

modifiers.notes: Native upstream dependency-order correction, no disabled Copper features, no custom compatibility shim and no Sophisticated removal

modifiers.before: End sky flash always enabled in End client level

after.missing_key: Existing six-key configuration retains true without changing its other values
after.effect: New native visual config page/group/toggle and tooltip keys in 32 existing Minecraft-namespace locale resources. Client level creates its EndFlashState only when enabled, changed setting takes effect on world rejoin

modifiers.notes: Native upstream ancillary feature. Existing behavior is preserved by the true default

after.recipe: Existing shaped six stripped Pale Oak logs to six minecraft:pale_oak_shelf result retained. Native palegardenbackport recipe unchanged

modifiers.notes: Both optional tag members remain required=false and replace=false. Corrected recipe remains conditional on the exact native mod ID

cause.owner: Native Copper Age Backport upstream dependency metadata, configuration and resources

rationale.purpose: Allow the user-requested Sophisticated Backpacks/Storage/Core installation to coexist with every installed Copper feature
rationale.decision_source: User requested Sophisticated migration while preserving existing pack behavior. Implementation selects the smallest official fixed native release 0.1.5 instead of custom patching or disabling compatibility

introduced.summary: Use native Copper Age Backport 0.1.5 fix #98 to load after Sophisticated Core/Storage while retaining native Copper content and existing settings

history.summary: Use native Copper Age Backport 0.1.5 fix #98 to load after Sophisticated Core/Storage while retaining native Copper content and existing settings

notes: Installed new JAR metadata confirms BOTH-side optional AFTER dependencies with unrestricted versionRange. Official release notes: https://modrinth.com/mod/backport-copper-age/version/6ij7gZ3z
Exact upstream version is a beta release. No automatic promotion or broader version upgrade is implied
Observed failed ordinary-server startup evidence: Server/local/sophisticated-update-20261024/publication.out.log at Copper compat init107 and Core PacketHandler constructor42

JAR entry comparison proves no class/resource removal except the renamed misspelled compatibility recipe. Gameplay registry, AI, chest/storage compatibility implementation, sounds and textures are byte-identical

Existing configuration retains golem spawning/buttons enabled, button chance5 percent, transport stack16 and native weathering21 to23 Minecraft days. New native missing-key default preserves End flash enabled
Release receipt owns artifact provenance and later delivery evidence. Stable profiles, MineRENT and immutable release baseline remain outside this update
unresolved: Successful ordinary-server restart and native AutoModpack publication/application require separate delivery evidence
Gameplay/client visual acceptance and every possible cross-mod runtime path are not proven by bytecode/resource inspection
